verdict.rationale: PayPal speaks two named third-party protocols: its ACP path tells developers to "Follow the ACP agentic checkout specification", and it also supports Google's UCP. Its own merchant cart API is publicly documented under a versioned v1 path (/api/agentic-commerce/v1). However, nothing in the pack shows these specs are openly licensed, versioned standards a developer can implement without signing up. Store Sync / agentic commerce services are form-gated, and UCP requires "UCP merchant registration with Google". Missing for 10: evidence that ACP/UCP are published as open, versioned specifications; a self-serve path to implement without access approval or registration; independent corroboration of spec openness.
